title: Light-pass barrier gives the depth texture the wrong before-state, and G-buffer resources are never moved back
fix_note: fix described in the issue (updated ApplyLightingPSO), no commit linked; D3D12 resource states ported to Vulkan image layouts
expected_finding: ApplyLightingPSO transitions mDsTexture with oldLayout DEPTH_STENCIL_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL while it is in DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL (written by the G-buffer pass); the G-buffer targets and depth texture are left in SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL, so the next frame renders the G-buffer into them in the wrong layout and the next barriers' old layouts are wrong (D3D12 RESOURCE_BARRIER_BEFORE_AFTER_MISMATCH)
